description: Recomputes MFM's long-term part of a price with the premium and the growth chosen by the user, with the same rule and bounds as the calculator of /en/top-down-bottom-up/#formula. Give exactly one of company (MFM company id: its owner earnings, multiplied by (1 + g + x) ÷ (ERP + s⁺ − x) with no payable share q because they are already net of all capital expenditure; counts as one company page of the account quota, nothing more if that company was already read today) or market (US, EU, JP, CA, CH: the net income of the basket's companies, the published bottom-up route; no quota). erp and x are fractions (0.04 = 4%, 0.01 = 1 point); defaults 4% and 0; out-of-range values are refused. Owner earnings, the payable share q, the return on equity, growth g and the spreads are measured and fixed. The result moves toward the market price but never past it. Optional sector (with market, US today: the sectors published in the sector table of /en/top-down-bottom-up/, by id such as information-technology or by name): the same calculation starting from that sector's published long-term part ÷ price and the market's parameters, plus the table of all the sectors of the market at the chosen erp and x; no live_price for a sector. Optional live comparison: live_price (company: price per share in the price currency; index or ETF: also month_end_price of the same instrument on MFM's price month): the default ratio is first rebased to the live price, then the stop at the price and the break-even are solved against the live price, as in the site calculator. Optional own top-down (market or sector, never a company): own_pe, or own_earnings with own_index_level, for own_month (YYYY-MM), or own_series (up to 24 months): index earnings or P/E that the user's AI fetched from the provider the user chose (as reported, operating, exchange statistics, factsheet trailing P/E with or without negative earnings: its terms of use are the user's responsibility; MFM does not supply index earnings). Returns, per month, the long-term part ÷ index level with MFM's K of that month (or the chosen erp and x, applied equally to MFM's bottom-up), MFM's bottom-up of the same month, the gap between the two (a ratio of earnings: the same at every erp and x) and, for a market, its position against MFM's declared band (whole percent: the month's value, the typical value = median of the last 60 months, and their lowest and highest). The gap and the band position are returned ONLY on the same reporting period: give own_period_end (YYYY-MM, last reporting period covered by the user's earnings); when it equals MFM's main period end of that month (same_period = true) they are given, otherwise both routes are returned without them and with comparison_reason_code (PERIOD_NOT_STATED, PERIOD_UNKNOWN_MFM, PERIOD_MISMATCH; E123_BEFORE_PIT_PANEL for a US month before 2021-11, the first point-in-time month of the earnings dataset). When the chosen erp and x make the long-term part cross the price and a parameter inside the ranges reaches it, the result stops at the price: chosen.erp and chosen.x are then the effective pair at the boundary (x solved at the requested erp, else erp at the requested x) and K, the payable share, the denominator and every ratio come from it; the requested pair is in requested and the formula's own figures without the stop in uncapped_at_requested (labelled, not a result). In own top-down the two routes of a month share one K: the first to reach the price sets it. Provisional months (official company prices not public yet: gap in whole percent only, no level) are never the starting point: a market reply starts from the latest month with official prices and gives the provisional months after it apart in provisional_months (gap, typical and largest error in percentage points, date by which the official prices are expected). Nothing is stored. The long-term part is dated, not real time. Descriptive only, never advice.

company.description: MFM company id, as in /en/company/<id>/ (e.g. aapl)

erp.description: Equity risk premium chosen by the user, fraction (default 0.04; range in the parameter file)

live_price.description: Live price fetched by the AI itself (optional), same unit and currency as MFM's price

market.description: Index or state with a published bottom-up long-term part

month_end_price.description: Index or ETF only: close of the same instrument on MFM's price month end, from the same source as live_price

own_earnings.description: Own top-down: index earnings per index unit (twelve months) from a provider chosen by the user; needs own_index_level

own_index_level.description: Own top-down: index level the earnings refer to (same provider, same month end)

own_month.description: Own top-down: month end (YYYY-MM) of own_pe or own_earnings/own_index_level; MFM's K and bottom-up of that month are used

own_pe.description: Own top-down (needs market, optionally sector): trailing index P/E from a provider chosen by the user, at the month end own_month

own_period_end.description: Own top-down (optional): last reporting period covered by the user's earnings (YYYY-MM), for the same-period check

own_series.description: Own top-down: a short monthly list instead of one month

sector.description: Sector of the market (needs market), id or English name as in the sector table, e.g. information-technology or Health care

x.description: Growth above the 10-year government bond rate, fraction (default 0; range in the parameter file)
